user.title: Abode Power Tariffs
user.description: One entry per metering channel — general consumption, controlled load, and so on. A working plan is created for you: one rate at 30 c/kWh covering the whole day. Change it under Configure.

data_description.plan_name: Shown on the device and used as the entity prefix.

abort.already_configured: A channel with that name already exists.

menu_options.general: Supply charge, tax, validity and sensors

rates_menu.title: Rates
rates_menu.description:
A rate is defined once and pointed at by any number of windows.

```
{rates}
```

rate_add.title: Rate
rate_add.description: Prices are entered in cents per kWh, as bills quote them, and published in dollars per kWh, as the Energy dashboard wants them.

data_description.constraints: Comma separated. Each one becomes a binary sensor that automations can trigger on, for example grid_charge_battery or no_grid_import.
data_description.daily_allowance_kwh: Leave empty for none. Some plans give a window free only up to a daily cap.
data_description.fallback_rate: Required when there is an allowance: what the energy costs once it is spent.

data_description.same_every_day: Leave this on unless weekends, weekdays or public holidays are priced differently.
data_description.days: Ignored while 'Same every day' is on. Public holidays need a holiday sensor nominated under the general settings.
data_description.season_from: Optional. Leave both empty for all year. A range may wrap the new year, for example 11-01 to 03-31.

day_set_duplicate.title: Duplicate a day set
day_set_duplicate.description: Copies the windows so a weekend or a season can be built from a shape that already works.

window_add.title: Window — {day_set}
window_add.description:
Start is included, end is not. A window that runs to midnight ends at 00:00.

```
{plan}
```

data_description.valid_to: When the retailer reprices, set this and create a new channel for the new plan, so past costs stay correct.
data_description.holiday_sensor: A workday binary sensor. Off on a public holiday.
data_description.import_energy_sensor: Only needed to count a daily energy allowance.

meters.title: Utility meters
meters.description:
Nominate utility meter tariff selects and they will be set to the rate in force at each window boundary, replacing the automation that usually does it. Nothing else is ever written.

The tariff names on the meter must match these rate names: {rates}

data_description.supply_charge_entities: The Energy dashboard has no field for a fixed daily charge. This creates a cost sensor and a matching token energy sensor to add as a second grid consumption source.

rate_plan_card.title: Rate plan card
rate_plan_card.description:
For transcribing into an inverter's own tariff screen. Nothing is sent anywhere.

```
{card}
```

error.bad_time: That is not a valid time.
error.validity_backwards: The plan cannot end before it starts.

get_intervals.name: Get intervals
get_intervals.description: Returns the forward series of priced intervals with the constraints in force.

resolution_minutes.name: Resolution
resolution_minutes.description: Length of each interval in minutes.
